Example 2: Multiple Verbs




::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# Sort Gentoo penguins from biggest to smallest with respect to their 
# bill length in cm (there are 10 mm in a cm)
penguins |> 
  filter(species == "Gentoo") |> 
  mutate(bill_length_cm=bill_length_mm/10) |> 
  arrange(bill_length_cm)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
# A tibble: 124 × 9
   species island bill_length_mm bill_depth_mm flipper_length_mm body_mass_g
   <chr>   <chr>           <dbl>         <dbl>             <dbl>       <dbl>
 1 Gentoo  Biscoe           40.9          13.7               214        4650
 2 Gentoo  Biscoe           41.7          14.7               210        4700
 3 Gentoo  Biscoe           42            13.5               210        4150
 4 Gentoo  Biscoe           42.6          13.7               213        4950
 5 Gentoo  Biscoe           42.7          13.7               208        3950
 6 Gentoo  Biscoe           42.8          14.2               209        4700
 7 Gentoo  Biscoe           42.9          13.1               215        5000
 8 Gentoo  Biscoe           43.2          14.5               208        4450
 9 Gentoo  Biscoe           43.3          13.4               209        4400
10 Gentoo  Biscoe           43.3          14                 208        4575
# ℹ 114 more rows
# ℹ 3 more variables: sex <chr>, year <dbl>, bill_length_cm <dbl>
```


:::
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# Sort the species from smallest to biggest with respect to their 
# average bill length in cm
penguins |> 
  mutate(bill_length_cm = bill_length_mm / 10) |> 
  group_by(species) |> 
  summarize(mean_bill_length = mean(bill_length_cm, na.rm = TRUE)) |> 
  arrange(desc(mean_bill_length))
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
# A tibble: 3 × 2
  species   mean_bill_length
  <chr>                <dbl>
1 Chinstrap             4.88
2 Gentoo                4.75
3 Adelie                3.88
```


:::
:::




Example 3: Interpret Code




::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
penguins |> 
  filter(species=="Chinstrap") |> 
  group_by(sex) |> 
  summarize(min = min(body_mass_g), max = max(body_mass_g)) |> 
  mutate(range = max - min)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
# A tibble: 2 × 4
  sex      min   max range
  <chr>  <dbl> <dbl> <dbl>
1 female  2700  4150  1450
2 male    3250  4800  1550
```


:::
:::




Exercise 1: More Filtering




::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# Create a dataset with just Adelie and Chinstrap using %in%
# Pipe this into `count(species)` to confirm that you only have these 2 species
 penguins |> 
   filter(species %in% c("Adelie","Chinstrap")) |> 
   count(species)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
# A tibble: 2 × 2
  species       n
  <chr>     <int>
1 Adelie      152
2 Chinstrap    68
```

```{.r .cell-code}
# Create a dataset with just Adelie and Chinstrap using !=
```
